# DonorPerfect Downsides

Based on user feedback and reviews, here are the main drawbacks of DonorPerfect:

## **User Interface & Usability**
- **Outdated interface** - Many users find it looks dated compared to modern CRM systems
- **Steep learning curve** - Not intuitive for new users; requires significant training
- **Clunky navigation** - Moving between features can be cumbersome

## **Reporting & Data**
- **Limited reporting flexibility** - Custom reports can be difficult to create without technical knowledge
- **Report building complexity** - Requires understanding of database structure; not user-friendly for non-technical staff
- **Data export limitations** - Some users report difficulties extracting data in desired formats

## **Technical Issues**
- **Slow performance** - Can lag, especially with larger databases
- **Frequent updates/changes** - System updates sometimes disrupt workflows or change familiar features
- **Integration challenges** - Connecting with other software can be problematic

## **Cost Concerns**
- **Add-on pricing** - Many useful features require additional paid modules
- **Hidden costs** - Total cost of ownership can exceed initial expectations
- **Training expenses** - May need to pay for ongoing training and support

## **Customer Support**
- **Variable support quality** - Response times and helpfulness can be inconsistent
- **Limited weekend/after-hours support** - May not suit all organization schedules

## **Customization**
- **Limited flexibility** - Difficult to customize without technical expertise
- **Rigid workflows** - May not adapt well to unique organizational processes

These issues don't affect all users equally, and some organizations find DonorPerfect works well despite these limitations.
